Scarlet & Violet series · PAL

Paldea Evolved

Released June 9, 2023 · 279 cards

StandardExpanded

Paldea Evolved is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on June 9, 2023. Its main set has 193 cards, plus 86 secret rares numbered beyond the set (279 in total). It includes 238 Pokémon, 35 Trainer and 6 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
